- requirement: "Every prompt-prompt issue will stop for a human. Fixes for ai:permission-prompt issues usually edit .claude/**, so under the new protected-path rule their projects stop and ask before that phase."
  expected_change_site: .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py, `issue_body()` (and workflow-templates copy)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `issue_body` "How to fix" steps do not mention the protected-path stop that permission-prompt fixes will trigger; the issue template text at lines 343-353 does not inform the implementer about the recorded approval described in CLAUDE.md §28.C.
- requirement: "Keep the “How to fix” step 3 guidance actionable when `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` is not present because companion PR #4592 has not landed."
  expected_change_site: .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py, `issue_body()`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The guidance in `issue_body` step 3 references `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`, which is not introduced by this PR and does not exist in the current repository.
- requirement: The PR description Notes section says: "Both PRs add a subsection at the end of CLAUDE.md §23 (§23.H there, §23.I here) and both edit the same /seed-repo asset-list line. Whichever merges second needs a small merge that keeps both sides."
  expected_change_site: N/A — this gap is acknowledged in the PR description as an intentional sequencing issue between PR #4592 and #4597.
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: CLAUDE.md §23.H (gh api write guard) is not present in this commit; `gh_api_write_guard.py` is not present; `implement-plan-claude.md` line 142 references "CLADE.md §23.H–§23.I" and `permission_prompts.py` line 346 references "CLAUDE.md §23.H gh api guard". These are all introduced by #4592. The PR description explicitly names this overlap and says the second-merge PR will handle it. Deferred scope — not a gap.
- requirement: The `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile` call should specify `encoding='utf-8'`.
  expected_change_site: .claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py, `_post_dispatch`, line 101
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Line 101 opens the tempfile as `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", delete=False)` with no `encoding="utf-8"`, while `.claude/scripts/edit_comment.py` and `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py` both open their equivalent tempfiles with `encoding="utf-8"`. The template copy `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py` has the same omission and must be kept byte-identical.
- requirement: No test covers the "POST succeeded, poll failed" path (consensus from cross-pollination)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_dispatch_workflow.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The test suite has `test_times_out_without_a_new_run` (polling returns empty until timeout) and `test_returns_the_new_run_not_the_previous_one` (happy path), but no test makes `_post_dispatch` succeed and then `find_new_run` raise `ReadError`. The `dispatched: false` bug on that path can be reintroduced without CI detection.
